title: The GUAPOS project. II. A comprehensive study of peptide-like bond molecules
question: Measure the column densities, abundances and spatial distribution of nine peptide-like bond molecules (HNCO, HC(O)NH2, CH3NCO, CH3C(O)NH2, CH3NHCHO, CH3CH2NCO, NH2C(O)NH2, NH2C(O)CN, HOCH2C(O)NH2) toward the hot core G31.41+0.31 from one spectral survey, then compare with other sources to constrain their formation

recipe.goal: Extract the Band 3 spectrum and subtract the continuum
recipe.method: Extract a spectrum over a beam-sized area at the continuum peak; split into 32 windows of 1 GHz, apply STATCONT c-SMC to each, average the continuum-subtracted windows with MADCUBA; fit a power law to the STATCONT continuum levels
key_parameters: Continuum uncertainty +/-1.2 K, 11% of the continuum level at the reference frequency 84.579 GHz, added to the fit errors
assumptions: Continuum brightness temperature follows a power law in frequency with alpha = 2 + beta for optically thin dust emission

recipe.method: Build LTE synthetic spectra in MADCUBA-SLIM from CDMS/JPL entries (plus added entries); identify other species preliminarily to evaluate line contamination
key_parameters: A line is non-contaminated if the peak of another species lies farther than FWHM from it; in a blend with separation below FWHM the contamination must be below 15%
assumptions: LTE with line opacity included, justified by n(H2) ~ 1e8 cm-3

recipe.goal: Fit LTE models to get N, Tex, vLSR and FWHM
recipe.method: MADCUBA-AUTOFIT non-linear least-squares fit of the LTE synthetic spectrum to the non-contaminated transitions of each species; vibrational states and 13C isotopologues fitted separately for HNCO, HC(O)NH2 and CH3NCO; CH3C(O)NH2 v=0 and vt=1,2 fitted together
key_parameters: Free parameters: column density N, excitation temperature Tex, peak velocity vLSR, FWHM; FWHM, vLSR and/or Tex fixed when the fit does not converge (e.g. HNCO FWHM fixed to 8 km/s; 13C isotopologue parameters fixed to the main species)
Total partition function Qvibrot = Qrot x Qvib when vibrational spectroscopy exists
assumptions: Emission fills the beam, so no beam dilution correction

recipe.goal: Correct for optical thickness to get final column densities
recipe.method: Where the main-isotopologue ground state is optically thick (HNCO, HC(O)NH2), take N from the optically thinner 13C isotopologue multiplied by the Galactic 12C/13C ratio; for CH3NCO adopt the vb=1 result; compare with the vibrationally excited states
key_parameters: 12C/13C = 37+/-12 at the galactocentric distance of G31 (5.02 kpc)
assumptions: 13C isotopologues and vibrationally excited states are optically thin; 12C/13C follows the Galactic trend

recipe.goal: Derive upper limits for non-detections and undetected states
recipe.method: Assume Tex, vLSR and FWHM from a related species or fixed values, then raise N to the maximum value compatible with the observed spectrum; MADCUBA upper limits on integrated intensity use 3 x rms x dv / sqrt(n_chan)
key_parameters: For NH2C(O)NH2, NH2C(O)CN, HOCH2C(O)NH2: Tex = 150 K, vLSR = 96.5 km/s, FWHM = 7 km/s; CH3CH2NCO uses the CH3NCO vb=1 values

recipe.method: X = N / N(H2), with N(H2) from the continuum inside the extraction area; abundances relative to CH3OH also derived

recipe.goal: Map the emission at 1.2'' and 0.2'' and test spatial consistency
recipe.method: Crop each cube around the rest frequency, subtract the continuum pixel by pixel, integrate four channels per transition; compare emission regions across Eup and molecules, and compare 1.4 mm column densities from the Band 6 data with the 3 mm ones
key_parameters: Velocity range for the maps 93 to 100 km/s; four channels correspond to 6.5 km/s at ~90 GHz

recipe.goal: Compare with other sources and fit abundance correlations
recipe.method: Compare abundances relative to H2 and to CH3OH, and column density ratios relative to HC(O)NH2, across hot cores, hot corinos, a GC cloud and comet 67P; fit power laws between pairs of abundances and report Pearson coefficients
key_parameters: A 25% error is assumed where literature errors are not given
assumptions: CH3OH column densities from 13CH3OH or CH3 18OH are corrected with 12C/13C and 16O/18O ratios as a function of galactocentric distance
